Comment.value: Arcane Archer initiation reagent (roadmap: arcane-archer-quest). Drawn from the old archery target on Rivendell's training ground (q_arc_target OnUsed, instance tag WardenMark) only when the PC comes as an archer -- longbow or shortbow equipped AND arrows in the quiver (QARC_ComesAsArcher in q_arc_inc). GetItemPossessedBy check at Halmir's turn-in (q_arc_c_rdy). Plot + cursed so it cannot be sold, dropped or traded; q_arc_finish clears the plot flag and consumes it.

value.0: A single arrow, grey-fletched in the fashion of the Galadhrim, drawn from the oldest target on Rivendell's proving ground by a hand that came bow in hand and arrow nocked. The wood is straight as the day it flew, an elder year ago, and when the wind moves it hums faintly, like a plucked string remembering its note. Halmir the Grey asked that it be carried back to him.
